plan.title: `deft update` re-deposits an untracked .github/workflows/deft-core-guard.yml after de-vendoring

narratives.Description: `deft update` re-deposits an untracked .github/workflows/deft-core-guard.yml after de-vendoring
narratives.Overview:
## Summary

After migrating a project to the npm-managed model and **de-vendoring** `.deft/core/` (removing it from git and gitignoring it, per `UPGRADING.md`), every `deft update` re-creates `.github/workflows/deft-core-guard.yml` on disk as an **untracked** file. Since that workflow's sole purpose is to guard against committing `.deft/core/**` alongside app changes, it's obsolete once `.deft/core/` is gitignored — yet it keeps coming back and shows up as untracked noise in `git status` (and risks being accidentally re-committed via `git add -A`).

## Environment

- Deft engine/payload: **v0.66.1** (also observed on v0.65.0)
- Install: npm-managed, CLI at `~/.deft-cli` (`managed_by: 'npm'`)
- Consumer project: `.deft/core/` gitignored and untracked (de-vendored)

## Steps to reproduce

1. Start from a project that had a committed (vendored) `.deft/core/` and the `deft-core-guard.yml` workflow.
2. Migrate to npm-managed and de-vendor: `git rm -r --cached .deft/core/`, add `.deft/core/` to `.gitignore`, and `git rm .github/workflows/deft-core-guard.yml`. Commit.
3. Run `deft update`.
4. `git status` → `.github/workflows/deft-core-guard.yml` reappears as `??` (untracked).

Each subsequent `deft update` re-deposits it, so it must be manually deleted every time.

## Expected

When `.deft/core/` is gitignored / not tracked (the recommended npm-managed layout), `deft update` should **not** re-deposit `deft-core-guard.yml` — the guard is meaningless when there's no committed `.deft/core/**` to guard. Ideally:

- Skip depositing the guard workflow when the deposit is gitignored / not git-tracked, **or**
- Detect that the consumer intentionally removed it and don't recreate it, **or**
- At minimum, document how to opt out of the guard deposit.

## Actual

`deft update` unconditionally re-lays down `.github/workflows/deft-core-guard.yml`, forcing a manual `rm` after every update to keep the working tree clean.

## Notes

Related: the `deft-core-guard` workflow is arguably fully obsolete under the npm-published model (v0.55.1+), since the vendored payload is no longer supposed to be committed. If that's the intent, the deposit could be dropped entirely.
narratives.ImplementationPlan: Deposit/refresh path: packages/core/src/init-deposit/refresh.ts (+ init-deposit/hygiene.ts). When .deft/core/ is gitignored / not git-tracked (the npm-managed layout), the refresh path must NOT re-deposit .github/workflows/deft-core-guard.yml -- the guard is meaningless with no committed .deft/core/** to guard. Gate the guard-workflow deposit on the deposit being git-tracked, and do not recreate it once the consumer has removed it. Tests: de-vendored (gitignored) tree -> update does not re-create the guard workflow; tracked-deposit tree -> guard still deposited.

expected_outputs: update does not re-deposit deft-core-guard.yml on a gitignored/de-vendored .deft/core tree
